question: A, which has an anomalous position in the Modern Periodic Table, depends on its properties. It has an electronic configuration of alkali metals but exists as diatomic molecules. B is the element that comes immediately after sodium in the third period and belongs to group C in the modern periodic table. Identify A, B, and C.
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 1**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A = Hydrogen** has an anomalous position in the Modern Periodic Table because it has an electronic configuration similar to alkali metals but exists as a diatomic molecule.
 
• **B = Mg** is the element that comes immediately after sodium (Na) in the third period and belongs to group 2 in the modern periodic table.
 
• **C = 2** is the group number to which magnesium (Mg) belongs in the modern periodic table.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hydrogen** is unique in the periodic table as it can act like an alkali metal as well as a halogen.
 
• **Magnesium (Mg)** is an alkaline earth metal and is found in group 2 of the periodic table.
 
• Group 2 elements are known for having two electrons in their outermost shell, which they tend to lose to form divalent cations.
 
• Magnesium is essential for many biological functions and is a key component in chlorophyll.
